title: 早上和妈妈去超市
topicEn: A Morning Trip to the Supermarket

explanations.1: 早上 indicates the time of day - morning.
explanations.2: 起床 means to get up, used after time.
explanations.3: 先 means 'first', indicating the order of actions.
explanations.5: 早饭 is the meal eaten in the morning.
explanations.6: 了 shows completion of the action of eating.
explanations.7: 面包 is one of the foods eaten for breakfast.
explanations.8: 很 is an adverb meaning 'very' to describe the taste.
explanations.9: 好吃 means delicious, describing the bread.
explanations.10: 问 means 'to ask', used when mom speaks to me.
explanations.11: 你 is the pronoun 'you', referring to the speaker.
explanations.12: 吗 turns the statement into a yes/no question.
explanations.13: 从 indicates the starting point 'from home'.
explanations.14: 里 means 'inside', indicating location within the supermarket.
explanations.15: 有 means 'there are', stating existence of fruit.
explanations.16: 没有 negates the action 'did not buy'.
explanations.17: 还 means 'also', adding another item mom bought.
explanations.18: 本 is a measure word for books.
explanations.19: 正在 indicates an action in progress.
explanations.20: 爸爸 is 'dad', the family member who returns home.

translation: This morning, I got up at seven. I drank water first. Then my mom and I had breakfast together. We ate bread and steamed buns. The bread was very delicious. Mom asked me, 'Do you eat a steamed bun?' I said, 'I eat one steamed bun.' Then we went to the supermarket from home. There were many fruits in the supermarket. Mom did not buy fruit. She bought apples and milk. What else did she buy? She also bought bread. What did I buy? I bought a book. How much money did we spend? We spent fifty-five yuan. After returning home, I was reading. In the afternoon, I slept. In the evening, Dad came home, and we had dinner together.
